svg.title: Dilation spreads a 3 by 3 kernel's taps apart, widening what one layer sees without adding weights
svg.desc: Three 9 by 9 grids with the nine taps of a 3 by 3 kernel filled in blue at dilation 1, 2 and 4, spanning 3, 5 and 9 pixels; below, the receptive field of the three layers stacked, 3, 7 and 15 pixels.

g.text: after dilation 1: 3 × 3; after dilation 2: 7 × 7; after dilation 4: 15 × 15
Doubling the dilation at each layer doubles the reach each time, with the image never shrunk.
